def CustomDataStruct():
    from .Data.dataquery import DataStruct as BaseDataStruct

    CustomDataStruct = BaseDataStruct(
        survey=None,
        catalogue=None,
        source=None,
        pos=None,
        identifier=None,
        data=None,
    )

    CustomDataStruct.subkind = None

    return CustomDataStruct
